topArticle.title: ‘Morocco feels emboldened’: Trump’s influence in spotlight after Ceuta disaster

Washington-Rabat ties under scrutiny as questions swirl over what led to deadly  influx into tiny Spanish territory
The cosy relationship between Washington and Rabat has long been flaunted by both sides, from Morocco’s announcement this year that it would be the first African state to join Donald Trump’s Board of Peace to the congratulatory message recently sent by Trump to mark King Mohammed VI’s 27 years in power.
The latest example landed this week. As Spain grappled with the aftermath of the sudden influx – and swift return – of more than 70,000 people into Ceuta, Morocco’s monarch confirmed he had named a $1bn highway flanking the disputed territory of Western Sahara after Trump.
 Continue reading...

As Abelardo de la Espriella takes office as president vowing a new military offensive, the country’s last leftwing rebels are getting ready to fight back
As the boat approached the riverbank, camouflaged figures watched from the tree line.
Behind them, in the dim understory of the jungle, a commander of the National Liberation Army (ELN) sat with his rifle on his lap, amid the buzz and whine of insects and the thwacks of machetes on bamboo as his troops set up camp, hidden from enemy drones.

Kindia, the zoo’s 20-year-old pygmy hippo, started showing signs of labor at around 8.15am last Sunday, it said. Around four hours later, the calf’s feet emerged and after 1.5 hours of active labor, Kindia successfully gave birth to the baby pygmy hippo.

topArticle.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
topArticle.description: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.
topArticle.titleJa: ニカラグア指導者、大統領任期をさらに1年延長することを提案
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアのダニエル・オルテガ指導者が、大統領任期をさらに1年延長することを提案。80歳になる彼の長期政権を可能にするため、憲法が改正されるのは今回が初めてではない。

topArticle.title: On the front line of Ecuador's drugs war, police fight gangs, guns and corruption
topArticle.description: The BBC goes on patrol with Ecuador's police, who are grappling with a huge surge in drug crime.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルの麻薬戦争最前線：警察はギャング、銃、汚職と戦う
topArticle.summary: エクアドルでは麻薬犯罪が急増しており、警察はギャング、銃、そして腐敗と戦う最前線に立たされている。BBCがその実情を報じた。

topArticle.title: One month after earthquakes, Venezuelans still search for loved ones and answers
topArticle.description: As families continue to look for missing loved ones, there is growing anger and resentment at the authorities.
topArticle.titleJa: 地震から1ヶ月、ベネズエラ人は愛する人々と答えを探し続ける
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラで地震が発生してから1ヶ月が経過したが、被災家族は依然として行方不明の愛する人々を捜し続けている。当局への怒りと不満が高まっている。

topArticle.title: Why was Taiwan’s president evacuated in the middle of the night?
topArticle.description: President William Lai took part in an emergency evacuation drill as part of Taiwan military exercises preparing for a potential Chinese invasion.
topArticle.titleJa: 台湾総統はなぜ真夜中に避難したのか？
topArticle.summary: 台湾の頼総統が中国侵攻を想定した軍事演習の一環として緊急避難訓練に参加した。

topArticle.title: Myanmar leader breaks diplomatic isolation on first official visit to Thailand since coup
topArticle.description: The military leader has been barred from western countries and accused of crimes against humanity.
topArticle.titleJa: ミャンマー指導者、クーデター後初のタイ公式訪問で外交的孤立を打破
topArticle.summary: クーデターで非難されるミャンマーの軍事指導者が、タイへの公式訪問で国際的孤立を破った。

topArticle.title: Moment first rare tiger in 70 years released in Kazakhstan
topArticle.description: Umit, a female Amur tiger, has been released as part of a programme to restore the animal's population, which was wiped out in central Asia a century ago.
topArticle.titleJa: カザフスタンで70年ぶりに希少なトラが放たれる瞬間
topArticle.summary: カザフスタンで絶滅したアムールトラの個体数回復プログラムの一環として、雌のトラ「ウミット」が放たれた。

topArticle.title: Ex-leader Hasina gambles on return to Bangladesh despite death penalty
topArticle.description: The 78-year-old has been convicted of crimes against humanity over a deadly crackdown on a 2024 uprising.
topArticle.titleJa: 死刑を宣告されながらもバングラデシュへの帰国を賭ける元指導者ハシナ氏
topArticle.summary: 2024年の暴動鎮圧に関連して人道に対する罪で有罪判決を受け、死刑宣告された元指導者ハシナ氏がバングラデシュへの帰国に踏み切る。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国と後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上支援に3万ユーロを供与
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは、途上国政府関係者の貿易研修プログラムを支援するため、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを拠出しました。
